name: Gitea Mirror
description: Gitea Mirror automatically mirrors your GitHub repositories to a self-hosted Gitea instance. It supports mirroring public and private repositories, organizations, starred repos, issues, wikis, and pull requests.
short_desc: Mirror your GitHub repositories to a Gitea instance automatically
author: RayLabs HQ

form_fields.label: Container User (UID:GID)
form_fields.hint: Process user and group ID (UID:GID). Keep 1000:1000 unless custom host permissions are required.
form_fields.pattern_error: Must be a numeric UID:GID (e.g. 1000:1000) or numeric UID (e.g. 1000)
